prefs.titulo: How you want to be notified

site.descricao: Choose what shows on this screen. Moderation notices always show: you have the right to know what happened to what you wrote.

tipos.ajudou: When your reply helped (never who marked it)
tipos.reacao_story: Reactions to your stories (never who reacted)

resumo.descricao: Off until you turn it on. Once a week, and only if there is something new: counts and titles of public conversations. Never the text of a post, never names.
resumo.ligar: Receive the weekly summary by e-mail
resumo.ver: See what would be sent now
resumo.nada: Nothing to send now: you have no new notifications.
resumo.precisaEntrar: To receive e-mail from Alumia, join Alumia first (18 or older, rules accepted).

push.descricao: The device only receives “You have N notifications on Alumia”, with no post text. Turn it off any time and the device is removed from our server.
push.semSuporte: This browser cannot send phone notifications.
push.bloqueado: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Allow them in the site settings and try again.
push.ios: On iPhone and iPad, first add the site to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
push.naoConfigurado: Phone notifications are not turned on for this site yet.
push.precisaEntrar: To get phone notifications, join Alumia first (18 or older, rules accepted).

servidor.lembrete24h: Reminder: an act you confirmed starts in less than 24 hours.
servidor.lembrete2h: Reminder: an act you confirmed starts in less than 2 hours.
